data_source: real: ctrl-vit training images (compilation images of the first-corpus fingers) against final D2, compilation real

train_embed.data_source: real: compilation images of the first-corpus (D1) fingers, compilation real (27,342 images, 3,684 fingers)

d2_embed.data_source: real: final D2, compilation real (18,493 images, 3,140 fingers)

near_duplicates.threshold_rule: D2 genuine pairs' 99.9th percentile of the cosine under ctrl-vit (all genuine pairs; numpy.quantile, linear interpolation); an image counts when its maximum cosine to any training image is at least it

finger_level.statistic: per D2 finger with >= 2 images: maximum over training fingers of the mean cross-cosine (dot product of mean embeddings) against its own genuine mean cosine

position_normalisation.note: casia_v5 codes <hand>0..3 and casia_ageing names <hand>_index/<hand>_middle are mapped to <hand>_<finger> (assumed from the CASIA-FingerprintV5 documentation: 0 thumb, 1 index, 2 middle, 3 ring; not verified on the images); finger codes are written as <source>:<code>, the compilation's identity notation; positions are compared only within a source or between linked families; numeric subject ids are compared after stripping leading zeros

label_structure.rule: D2 finger and a training finger in the other source of a linked family (casia_v5/casia_ageing, sd301/sd302) with the same numeric subject id and the same finger position
label_structure.position_normalisation_note: casia_v5 codes <hand>0..3 and casia_ageing names <hand>_index/<hand>_middle are mapped to <hand>_<finger> (assumed from the CASIA-FingerprintV5 documentation: 0 thumb, 1 index, 2 middle, 3 ring; not verified on the images); finger codes are written as <source>:<code>, the compilation's identity notation; positions are compared only within a source or between linked families; numeric subject ids are compared after stripping leading zeros

sensitivity.method: scripts/data/label_check.py (histogram AUC, 4000 bins over [-1, 1], ties count one half)

subset_rules.b_without_flagged: without the fingers reaching their own genuine mean
subset_rules.c_without_flagged_subjects: without those and every D2 finger whose subject_key matches a flagged finger's
